turns.speaker: Mark
turns.text: Okay everyone, great work last week, the beta numbers look really good. I'm honestly thrilled with how the launch went.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Thanks Mark. I think we should move the onboarding survey earlier, because users drop off right after sign-up and

turns.speaker: Mark
turns.text: Right, right, let's park that. Sam, where are we on the release checklist?

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: Honestly I'm worried. We still have twelve open bugs and the deadline is Friday. I'm not sure we can test everything in time.

turns.speaker: Jordan
turns.text: Wait, sorry, which deadline? I thought the release was next Friday. I'm a little lost on the timeline.

turns.speaker: Mark
turns.text: It's this Friday. That was decided last Tuesday.

turns.speaker: Jordan
turns.text: Okay. I don't follow how the hotfix branch fits in then. Are we merging it before or after the freeze?

turns.speaker: Mark
turns.text: Let's take that offline. Priya, you had something?

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Yes. Like I said earlier, the onboarding survey should come right after sign-up. I've raised this twice now and it keeps getting pushed. It's frustrating.

turns.speaker: Mark
turns.text: Fair. Okay, I love that idea actually, let's do it. Great call.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: I'm nervous about adding scope though. If we add the survey, QA gets even tighter. What if we miss critical bugs?

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: I'm confident it's small. I already have the designs ready and it's one screen. I can own it end to end.

turns.speaker: Mark
turns.text: This is unacceptable, by the way, the payment bug from last sprint is still open. Who dropped that?

turns.speaker: Jordan
turns.text: I think that was mine? I'm not sure what the expected behaviour was, the ticket was unclear.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: I'm a bit disappointed we cut the accessibility pass. That was the part I was most proud of.

turns.speaker: Mark
turns.text: Okay, we'll revisit accessibility next sprint. Let's keep moving.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Can we get a decision on who owns the payment bug before we leave?

turns.speaker: Mark
turns.text: Moving on. Jordan, how's the API migration?

turns.speaker: Jordan
turns.text: It's going well, I'm happy with it. The new endpoints are about thirty percent faster.

turns.speaker: Mark
turns.text: Awesome, that's fantastic news.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: I'm still anxious about Friday. Could we at least agree on a code freeze Thursday noon?

turns.speaker: Mark
turns.text: Sure, Thursday noon freeze.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Great. I'll have the survey merged by Wednesday so QA has a full day.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: Okay, sure, that works for me.

turns.speaker: Mark
turns.text: Perfect. Good meeting everyone.
